decision_rule: SPEECH iff voiced_frames >= 2 AND voiced_frames / complete_frames >= 0.1; otherwise NON_SPEECH
shared_arm_rule: The exact same contract bytes and implementation are used before both gated Qwen3-ASR and gated faster-whisper decoder arms.
fairness_rule: Raw decoder arms bypass this gate. faster-whisper internal VAD remains disabled in both raw and gated comparison arms.
